reuse.reason: The official DeepSeek plugin consumes Cordis Host services and the DSH Messages stream protocol; it cannot supply a Cloudflare Think AI SDK LanguageModel or the AI binding gateway transport. Forking that Host plugin would still require a separate SDK protocol bridge. This Workers provider reuses the unchanged exported official DEFAULT_MODELS and preserves canonical provider model ids. The AI SDK public request transformer applies the durable admitted off/low/high/max selection as documented DeepSeek Chat Completions thinking/reasoning_effort fields for both owner BYOK and platform gateway requests. No unsupported effort or client-only success is advertised.
gaps: Deployment-declared platform_ai entitlements are checked through the trusted owner Host before every provider attempt. The optional output-token cap bounds a single request; accumulated usage quotas and recalling already-started requests are not supplied.
